title: Public Alert No.043/2025 – Alert on UK Legal Claims Involving Johnson & Johnson Talc Baby Powder and Alleged Asbestos-Related Cancer Risks

products.manufacturer: Johnson and Johnson (A United States multinational corporation)

summary: NAFDAC alerts the public to UK lawsuits by over 3,000 claimants alleging Johnson & Johnson talc baby powder contained asbestos, linked to ovarian cancer and mesothelioma. The product is used in Nigeria. No conclusive regulatory finding yet; NAFDAC is monitoring.
